+def validate_batch_sequence_locators(raw, batch):
+    """Resolve the reviewed evidence against the original accession-indexed batch."""
+    rows = []
+    edges = {edge["id"]: edge for edge in raw["mechanistic_edges"]}
+    for edge_id, index, accession, expected_length, expected_sha in [
+        (
+            "sbn-edge-056",
+            0,
+            "Q2G1M5",
+            254,
+            "22a7f9fafd241b687178c976b2c893df6e2a1b58524ac89e54ed17cfddbadf18",
+        ),
+        (
+            "sbn-edge-058",
+            1,
+            "Q2G1N2",
+            336,
+            "cebe53926a46e6a5666972d57f6b058bec942f56b5775ebfee29dec643fbc0bb",
+        ),
+    ]:
+        evidence = edges[edge_id]["evidence"][1]
+        assert evidence["reference_id"] == "UniProtKB:" + accession, "Batch evidence accession"
+        comments, pointer = evidence["source_locator"].rsplit("; ", 1)
+        assert comments == f"/results/{index}/comments (CATALYTIC ACTIVITY; SUBUNIT)", (
+            "Batch comment locator"
+        )
+        assert pointer == f"/results/{index}/sequence/value", "Batch sequence locator"
+        entry = batch["results"][index]
+        assert entry["primaryAccession"] == accession, "Batch entry accession"
+        assert entry["organism"]["taxonId"] == 93061, "Batch source strain"
+        value = batch
+        for token in pointer.lstrip("/").split("/"):
+            value = value[int(token)] if isinstance(value, list) else value[token]
+        sequence_sha = hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()
+        assert len(value) == expected_length and sequence_sha == expected_sha, (
+            "Batch sequence identity"
+        )
+        assert {"CATALYTIC ACTIVITY", "SUBUNIT"} <= {
+            comment["commentType"] for comment in entry["comments"]
+        }, "Batch comment evidence"
+        rows.append(
+            dict(
+                edge=edge_id,
+                accession=accession,
+                pointer=pointer,
+                length=len(value),
+                sequence_sha256=sequence_sha,
+            )
+        )
+    return rows
